description: Route every outbound HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket request through a local proxy — Clash Verge, Mihomo, V2Ray, Shadowsocks, or any HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy.

detection.empty: No local proxy found on the well-known ports. Configure one manually in the General tab.
detection.heading: Detect a local proxy
detection.quickClash: Clash / Mihomo core v{version} detected on 127.0.0.1:9090 — run a detection to list its ports.

source.config: Port read from the client's config file
source.process: Client process detected, using its default port

detection.subheading: Discovers FlClash, Clash Verge Rev, Mihomo, and v2rayN via running processes and config files, then probes the well-known loopback ports.
detection.webUnsupported: Auto-detection requires the Tauri desktop app.

form.bypassHint: Hosts and domain suffixes that should skip the proxy. Add a leading dot to match a domain suffix (e.g. ".internal").
form.proxyWebsocketsHint: Tunnel Discord Gateway, Slack Socket Mode, and other WSS connections through the proxy via HTTP CONNECT or SOCKS5.

modeHint.auto: Filled in via Auto-detect; behaves the same as Manual once set.
modeHint.off: Direct connections — ignore any proxy settings.

test.webUnsupported: Live proxy testing requires the Tauri desktop app.

title: Network Proxy
